left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  All newly registered patients with smear-positive recurrent pulmonary TB
  -  Adults  [OR] as well as children (no age limit)
  -  Able and willing to provide written informed consent
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients transferred to a health facility not supported by Damien Foundation will be excluded

right.raw_text: This includes patients diagnosed with HIV/ [OR] TB-coinfection
